title: Computation with positive integers
summary: Place value, adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing whole numbers, estimating and rounding, and the order of operations.

cards.title: Ancient number systems
cards.rule: Roman numerals add up, but a smaller symbol before a larger one means subtract.

cards.title: Place value
cards.rule: Each digit's value depends on where it sits. A zero holds an empty place.
lines: 507: the zero holds the tens place

cards.title: Adding and subtracting
cards.rule: Round to a friendly number, then adjust.

cards.title: Algorithms for + and −
cards.rule: Line up the place values, then carry or borrow.
cards.tip: line up the units, not the left-hand digits.

cards.title: Multiplying small numbers
cards.rule: Split a number into tens and units. Order doesn't matter, so pair numbers that are easy.

cards.title: Multiplying large numbers
cards.rule: Multiply by each digit, then add the parts.

cards.title: Dividing
cards.rule: Short division: divide one digit at a time, carrying what's left.

cards.title: Estimating and rounding
cards.rule: Look at the next digit: 5 or more rounds up.
lines: 387 to the nearest 10 is **390**, to the nearest 100 is **400**

cards.title: Order of operations
cards.rule: Brackets first, then × and ÷ from left to right, then + and − from left to right.
cards.tip: don't just work from left to right.
